capabilities: Place notes on orbits by link distance from a chosen home note
Animate a rotating galaxy with up to 15,000 star dust particles
Highlight links on hover and open notes on click
Control camera with drag, scroll zoom, Shift-pan and double-click reset
Update the view when notes are added, renamed or linked
extras: Works fully offline and only reads note names and links from Obsidian's metadata cache; canvas view pauses while hidden and star dust can be lowered on slow devices. English and German interface.
problem: Obsidian offers no animated, galaxy-style visual overview of how notes are linked together.
summary: Renders the vault as a rotating galaxy: home note as sun, linked notes as stars on tilted orbits with star dust.
